title: Oncall rehearsal simulator and safe-query mock runner
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: On-call teams need low-friction, low-risk rehearsals (drills) that exercise runbooks, live-query workflows, and escalation paths without touching production data or altering live service state. This PR introduces an oncall rehearsal simulator that schedules and runs scenario-based drills in a sandboxed environment and a safe-query mock runner that rewrites and replays live queries against deterministic mocks. Motivation: reduce cognitive load during drills, capture realistic responder paths, and produce rehearsal artefacts (timelines, evidence bundles, and a postmortem starter) for continuous improvement. Summary of changes: - rehearsal/simulator: core engine that loads scenario definitions, orchestrates steps, enforces time windows, and records timeline events - rehearsal/mock_query_provider: safe-query translator that converts SQL/GraphQL/PromQL queries into non-invasive mocked calls and validates that no writes or destructive ops occur - runner_cli + web hooks: lightweight runner for scheduled or ad-hoc rehearsals; supports "silent" mode (no real paging) and a "replay" mode tied to synthetic telemetry - failure injection: deterministic fault generator (latency, partial errors, throttling) to simulate realistic partial failures - evidence pack exporter: one-click packaging of logs, synthetic traces, and decisions to seed postmortems and evals - policy checks: preflight RBAC & tenancy checks to guarantee drills cannot cross customer namespaces or mutate infra - docs: onboarding guide and example scenarios Example usage: 1) Define a scenario YAML in docs/oncall/examples/ (traffic spike, DB connection storm, stale cache) 2) run `stool rehearsal run --scenario traffic-spike --silent` to exercise responders without sending pages 3) after completion, use the web UI to export evidence and auto-generate a draft postmortem Checklist (what this PR includes): - [x] core simulator engine and scheduler - [x] safe-query mock provider (SQL/PromQL/GraphQL) - [x] CLI + web hooks + sample scenarios - [x] unit tests and integration tests with mocked telemetry - [x] docs and example scenario gallery - [x] preflight safety checks and RBAC gating Testing notes: unit coverage added for query translation and simulator state machine; integration tests run a full rehearsal in a CI sandbox using mocked backends and verify no production endpoints are contacted. Locally tested a 3-step scenario with silent Slack notifications and verified evidence export contains timeline + sanitized traces. Rollout plan: feature gated behind `rehearsal.enabled` flag and an org-level permit. Initially enable for internal SRE and a small set of partner teams. Monitor rehearsal telemetry (duration, false-positives, infra calls) and surface regressions in the Redwood Console. Risks and mitigations: - Risk: accidental pages to oncall during drills. Mitigation: default to silent mode and require explicit `--allow-paging` and org-level permit to enable real routing. CI also runs a sanity check that ensures no PagerDuty/notification credentials are present. - Risk: query translator may accidentally allow destructive clauses. Mitigation: strict query sanitizer, read-only rewrite rules, and a denylist for certain patterns. - Risk: scenario complexity leaking into production configs. Mitigation: scenarios are stored under `rehearsal/` namespace by default and preflight prevents cross-namespace mounts. Related work: ties into incident-bot's runbook previews and incident snapshot exporters (future PR will add automatic handoff to incident-bot).

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Really like the simulator state-machine shape. Two requests: add a short-circuit for long-running scenarios in CI (so PRs don't time out) and add metrics for "synthetic paging" vs "silent" runs.
Author (Maya Patel): thanks — added a CI short-circuit flag and instrumentation for rehearsal.mode in metrics (see simulator.py).
Priya Raman: The query rewrite looks good but we need a formal denylist for clauses that can mutate state. Please surface failures to the operator and fail-fast at preflight.
Author (Maya Patel): implemented denylist and a preflight check that aborts the run with a visible error; added unit tests for common malicious patterns.

release_notes: Add on-call rehearsal simulator with safe-query mock runner: enables org-gated, sandboxed drills, deterministic fault injection, and one-click evidence export. Feature gated; enable for internal SRE first.
risk_and_mitigation: Default to silent mode and require explicit org permission to enable paging. Strict query sanitizer and denylist prevent destructive queries. Preflight RBAC checks prevent cross-namespace scenario mounts.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover query translation and state transitions; integration test exercises a 3-step scenario in CI sandbox with mocked telemetry and verifies evidence export and no outbound production notifications.
